name: FinCrime Control Lab
journeys: Use TypologyIQ: pick a firm type, product, customer type and risk theme, view results, then open one typology's detail page. Check the results make sense for the inputs.

Start a new product risk assessment (/assess/product-risk/new) and work through as many of the 8 steps as you can, including going back a step and refreshing mid-flow. Check nothing you entered is lost.
Try to download a PDF from a free tool and check the email gate: invalid emails should be rejected with a clear message.
Create an incident (/assure/incidents/new), then check it appears on /workspace and in the incidents list with the details you entered.
